environmental-services-value-chain/indus.name: Industrial & Sewer Cleaning Services
environmental-services-value-chain/indus.description: DACH-wide field of compliance-driven, recurring cleaning, inspection and emptying services for municipal sewers, industrial plant, drainage infrastructure and hazardous confined spaces. The market is highly fragmented into thousands of owner-operated regional firms (~1,963 dedicated pipe/sewer-cleaning firms in Germany alone), driven by statutory maintenance mandates (DIN 1986-30, DIN 4040/EN 1825, AwSV, Eigenkontroll-/Selbstueberwachungsverordnungen) and increasingly targeted by PE buy-and-build on succession gaps.

environmental-services-value-chain/indus.description: High-pressure flushing and vacuum removal of sewers, house connections and property drainage, paired with camera condition surveys and statutory leak-testing. Buyers are municipalities/Abwasserverbaende and private property owners obligated to maintain their Grundstuecksentwaesserung.

rationale.recurring: Maintenance flushing on multi-year cycles plus statutory re-inspection intervals (DIN 1986-30 recommends ~20yr repeat, 5-10yr in water-protection zones) create durable repeat demand.
rationale.fragmentation: ~1,963 dedicated pipe/sewer-cleaning firms in Germany; VDRK trade body lists a long tail of SME members, no dominant consolidator.
rationale.compliance: DIN 1986-30 and state Selbstueberwachungs-/Eigenkontrollverordnungen make inspection and leak-testing a legal obligation of property owners and network operators.

dach_signals.revenue_band_eur: EUR 0.3-5m typical owner-operated; regional groups EUR 10-50m

environmental-services-value-chain/envir.name: Environmental Consulting, Monitoring & Compliance
environmental-services-value-chain/envir.description: DACH-wide services that measure, permit, monitor and report environmental and workplace-safety compliance for industrial and construction operators, driven overwhelmingly by mandatory law (BImSchG, GefStoffV, WHG, KrWG, CSRD). The segment is highly fragmented into hundreds of accredited measuring bodies (Messstellen), engineering permitting firms (Ingenieurbüros), outsourced statutory officers, ESG/carbon advisors and ecological surveyors, with no dominant consolidator below the TIC majors (TÜV/DEKRA/SGS).

environmental-services-value-chain/envir.name: Emissions & Immissions Measurement (accredited Messstellen)
environmental-services-value-chain/envir.description: Statutorily mandated stack/ambient measurement of air pollutants, noise and vibration on permitted industrial plants, performed by bodies formally notified under §29b BImSchG and accredited to DIN EN ISO/IEC 17025.

rationale.recurring: Operators of §4 BImSchG plants must have recurring emission measurements at fixed intervals (often every 1-3 years), re-commissioned each cycle (§§26,28 BImSchG).
rationale.fragmentation: §29b bodies range from TÜV/DEKRA/Müller-BBM/WESSLING down to regional labs like öko-control; state registers list many bodies via ReSyMeSa with no single dominant player.
rationale.compliance: Measurement is legally compelled and can only be performed by a formally notified (bekannt gegebene) body, a pure compliance market.

dach_signals.revenue_band_eur: EUR 1-15m typical body; single campaign EUR 5-50k

rationale.recurring: Delivered on multi-year retainers with ongoing statutory duties (annual reports, plant inspections), inherently recurring.
rationale.fragmentation: Many regional consultancies and freelance experts (proenvi, CIVAC, isuplan, Sicherheitsingenieur.NRW) with no consolidator.

environmental-services-value-chain/recyc.name: Recycling & Materials Recovery

It is a fragmented, largely SME-owned, compliance-and-commodity-driven space where legal collection/recycling quotas (KrWG, ElektroG, VerpackG, BattG, AltfahrzeugV, EBV) create recurring statutory volume while output value is exposed to volatile commodity/recyclate prices (a reimbursement-risk analogue).

environmental-services-value-chain/recyc.name: Metal Scrap Recycling (Schrott / NE-Metalle)

environmental-services-value-chain/water.name: Decentralized Sewage Plants (Kleinklaeranlagen) Service & Emptying
environmental-services-value-chain/water.description: Statutory annual maintenance (Wartung) and periodic faecal-sludge emptying of the ~1.2 million small/decentralized sewage treatment plants in Germany, which by law must be serviced under a maintenance contract with a certified specialist, not the owner. A classic fragmented, mandated, recurring niche.

rationale.recurring: Wartung is legally required at least once a year (biological plants often 2-3x) plus sludge emptying every 1-2 years - fully recurring.
rationale.fragmentation: Served by thousands of local Wartungsfirmen and Abwasserzweckverbaende; no dominant consolidator across ~1.2m plants.
rationale.compliance: DIN 4261-4 / DIN EN 12566 plus water-law approvals make maintenance and emptying mandatory and owner-self-service prohibited.

dach_signals.revenue_band_eur: EUR 100-250 per Wartung; EUR 200-400 per emptying; firms EUR 0.3-3m

environmental-services-value-chain/water.name: Drinking-Water & Legionella Testing
environmental-services-value-chain/water.description: Statutory sampling and accredited-lab analysis of building/network drinking water - notably systemic Legionella testing - under TrinkwV, where sampling and analysis must be commissioned together from an approved testing body. rationale.compliance: TrinkwV mandates testing only by listed/approved bodies; sampling cannot be separated from analysis - hard mandate.

rationale.fragmentation: Few large (mostly consortium/utility-backed) mono-incineration and P-recovery plants; capital intensity precludes fragmentation.
rationale.compliance: AbfKlaerV mandates P-recovery from 2029 and bans soil application for large plants (>100k EW 2029, >50k EW 2032).
